build_MochiTransformer3DModel: build a MochiTransformer3DModel for video-like data with patch embeddings, timestep caption embedding, and transformer blocks
create_MochiTransformerBlock: create a MochiTransformerBlock with multi-head attention, feed-forward networks, and adaptive RMS normalization for hidden and context states
use_MochiRoPE: use MochiRoPE to generate 3D rotary positional embeddings for spatiotemporal video data with configurable base dimensions
use_MochiRMSNormZero: use MochiRMSNormZero to apply adaptive RMS normalization that outputs scale and gate values for attention and MLP gating
use_MochiLayerNormContinuous: use MochiLayerNormContinuous to apply adaptive layer normalization conditioned on an embedding vector with SiLU activation
